Main.dc.html.title: Prototype: one call, one screen that morphs

Today.dc.html.title: Today: the advisor call as built

t1.text: The idea, and what we have now

t3.text: The same call on a phone, then administration, then the rules

n1.text: Press the four steps under the call bar. Every region you see is the same element in every step: it grows, shrinks or hands over, nothing is thrown away and redrawn.

n2.text: Today: a white strip, wrapping text links, one column of cards. Everything is the same weight, so nothing says what to do next.

n3.text: Anchors never move: rail, top bar, call bar, role chip. The live board shrinks into a strip once the call starts.

n4.text: The needs collapse into a pinned summary, so the options can have the room. Edit puts them back.

n5.text: One option takes the stage. The others fold into a rail, still one tap away. A request needs one confirmation.
